parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values for human single-protein target CHEMBL1795151. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1795151', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
